newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent, gas oil touch session highs on U.S. ope.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent, gas oil touch session highs on U.S. ope.

text.p: IPE Brent and gas oil futures extended earlier gains shortly after the NYMEX open, supported by a strong opening move on U.S. heating oil futures.
IPE Dec Brent was trading 21 cents up at $22.40 a barrel by 1501 GMT, with Nov gas oil $3.25 higher at $211.75 a tonne.
"NYMEX came in pretty unchanged from ACCESS, but now we're seeing a bit of a push up which has helped Brent out of its range," said one broker.
U.S. inventory data showed an unexpected draw on heating oil stocks last week.

According to Energy Information Administration (EIA) data today, distillate stocks fell 500,000 barrels last week, while American Petroleum Institute (API) data from Tuesday showed a draw of 429,000 barrels. Analysts had expected a build in stocks of some 2.5 million barrels.
For crude, the EIA reported a build of 10.1 million barrels, while API figures estimated a 9.30 million barrels increase in crude stocks.
"The APIs for crude were a bit bearish but that's being counteracted by heating oil," said an IPE floor broker.
